description: Lists client invites, newest first, one per email. Use when the user asks who has not accepted yet, which invites failed, or wants an invite ID to resend or cancel. Not for clients who already joined (use list_clients). Returns invite IDs, names, emails and status, up to 100.

status.description: Invite filter: pending = waiting for the client; error = email failed; accepted = joined; rejected = declined; canceled = withdrawn by the team; all = every invite. Omit for open invites (everything except accepted and canceled).

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_client_invites
title: List client invites
